content.text:
I fixed the pricing page on mobile. At a 375px viewport the three plan cards now stack in one column, each 343px wide, and the page no longer scrolls sideways.

The cause was in `site/css/pages.css`. The `.plans` grid is three columns, and the mobile rules (`max-width: 720px`) left it out, so the cards got squeezed side by side on a phone. I added `.plans` to the existing mobile rule that collapses the other grids to one column. That's a one-line change.

The functional tests pass (16 of 16). I only checked the layout by measuring widths in a headless browser, not by looking at a screenshot. The repo has a single commit, so I couldn't see which change broke it. This is the problem I found on the page, and I didn't look for other causes.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
